title: Persuasive Essay Rubric

criteria.name: Thesis & Focus
criteria.description: A clear, arguable thesis is stated early and every paragraph serves it.

criteria.name: Evidence & Support
criteria.description: Claims are backed by specific, accurate, relevant evidence.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: Logical paragraph order, clear topic sentences and transitions.

criteria.name: Counterargument
criteria.description: Anticipates and rebuts a serious opposing view.

criteria.name: Conventions
criteria.description: Grammar, spelling and punctuation are essentially error-free.

notes: Deduct for off-topic content and factual inaccuracies.
